title: Gaussian lower-left quadrant probability
statement: Let $\rho\in(-1,1)$, and consider the centered bivariate Gaussian distribution with covariance matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&\rho\\ \rho&1\end{pmatrix}$. The probability that both coordinates are nonpositive is $\frac12-\frac{1}{2}\frac{\arccos(\rho)}{\pi}$.
